sub: high protein · ketogenic-centric · vegan with eggs · soy-free · thyroid-smart
cycleNote: The same week repeats. Monday to Friday and Sunday are keto. Saturday is the strength-day refeed at about 55 g net carbs. Wednesday and Sunday are rest days with the 19:5 window; the other five days are workout days with the 16:8 window.

tierText.KETO: 30 g net carbs or less (about 50 g total with 20 to 25 g of fiber). Egg whites and eggs, seitan, pea protein, low-carb vegetables, avocado, coconut, nuts and seeds.
tierText.MED: About 55 g net carbs, once a week on a strength day. The same base plus quinoa, sweet potato, berries or fruit at the later meals. A planned higher-carb day supports hard training and is often used so a slow thyroid is not held at very low carbs all week.

rules: EAT
var(--p)
Protein: egg whites, whole eggs, seitan, pea protein powder, nutritional yeast, hemp seeds, pumpkin seeds
Low-carb vegetables: spinach (wilted), zucchini, mushrooms, asparagus, cucumber, celery, romaine, tomato, a little bell pepper
Fats: olive oil, avocado, coconut milk and oil, olives, macadamias, walnuts, almonds, chia, flax, tahini
Refeed day only: quinoa, sweet potato, berries, apple, orange, banana, a few lentils
Water 2.5 to 3 L a day, plus salt to taste (iodized) and electrolytes during the first two weeks
LIMIT
var(--c)
Net carbs: 30 g or less on keto days, about 55 g on the Saturday refeed
Whole eggs: 2 or fewer a day and 8 or fewer a week (egg whites are not counted)
Seitan: 8 oz or less a day. It is wheat gluten, so skip it if she is gluten-sensitive
Pea protein powder: 3 scoops or fewer a day, and 2 or fewer in one meal
Bell peppers and green beans: about ½ cup at a time on keto days
NOT USED
var(--keto)
Soy in any form: tofu, tempeh, edamame, soy milk, miso, soy sauce, tamari, textured vegetable protein, soy protein and soy lecithin. Read labels
Cruciferous vegetables: broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, kale, Brussels sprouts, bok choy, collards, arugula, radishes, turnips, mustard greens
Other goitrogens: peanuts and millet
Dairy, meat, poultry and fish
Added sugars, kelp and other iodine supplements
monitoring: Workout days (strength Mon, Thu, Sat; HIIT Tue, Fri): 16:8, eat 12–8 PM, three meals. Rest days (Wed, Sun): 19:5, eat 3–8 PM, two meals. Water, plain sparkling water, black coffee and tea are fine once the levothyroxine wait is over. Train before the first meal when you can.

Weigh in once a week, same day, fasted, and track the 7-day average. After the first one to two weeks of water loss, expect about 0.75 to 1 lb a week. Do not cut below the plan's calories if progress slows; first check sleep, stress, steps and labs with the physician.

Take the thyroid medication (such as levothyroxine) every morning on waking with water only, at the same time daily, and wait 30 to 60 minutes before coffee or food. Keep iron, calcium, magnesium and fiber supplements 4 hours after the dose. Stop a fast and eat if she feels dizzy, shaky or has a racing heart.

Repeat TSH, free T4 and free T3 with the physician at 8 to 12 weeks, with a lipid panel, B12, ferritin, vitamin D and electrolytes. Weight loss can change the dose she needs, so the physician adjusts it, never her. Pause biotin (in B-complex) 3 to 5 days before blood draws. Report a racing heart, tremor or poor sleep, or worse fatigue, cold, constipation or hair loss.
never: Soy in any form: tofu, tempeh, edamame, soy milk, miso, soy sauce, tamari, textured vegetable protein, soy protein and soy lecithin
Cruciferous vegetables: broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, kale, Brussels sprouts, bok choy, collards, arugula, radishes, turnips, mustard greens
Added sugars, kelp and other iodine supplements
limitNote: Whole eggs are capped at 2 a day and 8 a week. Seitan is capped at 8 oz a day and pea protein at 3 scoops a day. Keto days stay at 30 g net carbs or less.
tierNote: Keto days use the base meals. The refeed day adds the carb sides marked with a plus sign in the meal cards.
checkSuffix: · no soy, cruciferous vegetables, dairy, meat or fish.

caps.lentil: Refeed day only · about 40 g carbs per cup

swapLimits: The egg limits (2 a day, 8 a week) and the keto limit (30 g net carbs) stay in force. A swap that breaks one shows a red warning.
footer: Macros are estimates from standard food-composition values and can vary by 5–10%. Review calories, fasting windows, supplements and any dose change with the treating physician, especially while levothyroxine is being adjusted.
groceryNote: Spinach is measured raw and wilted in the pan. Sweet potato is weighed baked. Check pea protein and seitan labels for soy.
